about: Phase 2 of the equipment screen's art (docs/art-handoff-equipment-pieces.md): the bare body region by region (plates) and every piece as it's worn. Upload each file to its 'file' path. Make what a file is painted on with `python3 tools/equipment_pieces.py inputs`, and check deliveries with `python3 tools/equipment_pieces.py check`.
style: Inked cel illustration for a 2D fantasy game's equipment screen. One clean, uniform, dark outline (#15101f) around every shape, thinner inner lines in the same ink, flat colour fills with exactly three tone steps per material (shadow, mid, light), light from the top left at 45 degrees, no gradients, no texture noise, no cast shadows, no glow, no text, no watermark, no frame, no border.
palette: Materials, each in exactly three flat tones: steel and iron in neutral grey with no tint at all (shadow #4a4a4f, mid #8a8a90, light #cfcfd4; the game recolours plain metal for each era, so never tint, blue, gild or blacken it unless asked); leather in warm brown (#4a2f22, #7a5038, #a77552); gold and brass (#7a4f12, #c48a22, #f2c45a); wood (#4b3220, #7b5534, #a77a4e); bone, horn and ivory (#8f7f63, #c9b994, #ece2c8); gemstones as clear colourless crystal, white with pale grey facets (the game tints them); cloth in the dye named, muted, never bright. No colours of the rarity ladder (no bright green, blue, purple, orange, red, pink or cyan), no glow, no magic light, no sparkles, and nothing green at all: the background green is keyed out.
tattoo_ink: Tattoo ink: flat dark blue-black ink (#1b1f2e) on the skin, crisp lines and solid shapes with no shading, no outline round the design and no colour; it follows the curve of the body and the skin's own light shows between its lines (the game tints the ink).
